usage: cox chair run [-h] [--once] [--interval INTERVAL] [--dry-run]

Each tick beats the chair lease, gathers facts, plans, performs and reports one status line.
It yields to `cox route chair take --steal`: actions planned under a lost lease are fenced.
It hard-stops at the profile's weekly_hard_stop_fraction of the weekly ceiling.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --once               run one tick, release the lease, exit 1 if the tick errored
  --interval INTERVAL  seconds between ticks (default: 60)
  --dry-run            plan and report each tick without taking the lease or performing any action
